visual_grasp_transfer.description: Localize graspable object parts and receiving regions; transfer rigid objects with visual verification.
visual_grasp_transfer.conditions: Object and destination geometry can be identified in current RGB views.
visual_grasp_transfer.guidance: Identify a graspable part and jaw direction from current views. Check destination reach before grasping. Verify retention after lifting. Align the held object, accounting for its offset from the fingertips, and release near visible support. Re-localize the destination after transport.

relative_alignment.description: Closed-loop orientation and position alignment for placement, pushing and contact approach.
relative_alignment.conditions: A target relation is observable; contact and geometric uncertainty require short corrections.
relative_alignment.guidance: Ground target position and orientation in the current images. Use short motions near contact, inspect their effect, and update the alignment. A motion-planner success does not prove object contact or task completion.

symbolic_selection.description: Read visible symbols or language-specified attributes and determine the requested objects or order.
symbolic_selection.conditions: The instruction requires counting, ordering, matching, or language-conditioned object selection.
symbolic_selection.guidance: Record the visible symbols or attributes and the reasoning that determines the requested selection. Resolve ambiguity by observation. Maintain an explicit tally of completed actions, incrementing it only after visual or execution confirmation.

temporal_observation.description: Observe demonstrations or transient events and preserve their order within the episode scratchpad.
temporal_observation.conditions: The instruction depends on earlier observations, a demonstrated sequence, or an event that may disappear.
temporal_observation.guidance: Observe before intervening when a demonstration or event sequence is in progress. Preserve identities and event order in the existing episode memory. Separate observed events from hypotheses and do not import memories from prior evaluation episodes.

verify_recover.description: Verify progress and recover from failed motion, uncertain grasp and scene displacement.
verify_recover.guidance: Verify effects using the newest images and actual state. Treat low gripper opening as uncertain retention for thin objects. After failed motion, replan from the actual pose and avoid repeating the same unreachable request. Preserve the native budget and never invent completion.

continuous_visual_control.description: WorldScape continuous learned visual action execution using its temporal history and absolute joint chunks.
continuous_visual_control.conditions: Three decoded RGB cameras and the 14-dimensional robot joint state are available. Task success must be empirically validated.
